title: Two-step oxidative amidation of benzyl alcohol
protocol: Benzyl alcohol and morpholine were used in a 1:1 ratio in dioxane at 0.667 M. TBHP was the oxidant, with NaBr and sulfuric acid promoting oxidation and amidation. The two-step batch sequence was operated at 80 C for a total of 30 min and afforded benzoyl morpholine in 76% yield.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.
